title: feat: Support baseURL config setting
body:
With the new provider option would be great to allow to set the baseURL as well.

This would allow to fx. use Ollama on another host than the same host as codex (localhost is hardcoded at this point).

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves configuration settings related to an LLM provider, specifically the ability to set a baseURL for provider integration, which aligns with the criteria for agent issues concerning LLM provider usage and configuration.
